criteria.name: Reference fidelity and justified departures
criteria.acceptance_evidence: Version-specific full-text/source hashes; section/protocol map; verify necessary mechanisms; Taylor distinct; no imported performance

criteria.name: Important incremental contribution
criteria.acceptance_evidence: Consequential frozen mechanism beyond geography, primary-source comparison including limitations of unavailable revised methods; empirical mechanism estimate

criteria.name: Source/timing/persona/label validity
criteria.acceptance_evidence: Pre-cutoff sourced input histories and membership, declared missing history/labels, typed rate and stance targets; eligible frozen cohort

criteria.name: Identification, baselines and empirical execution
criteria.acceptance_evidence: Equal prefix/matched branch resource allocation, own state retained, chair copying excluded, fresh live final generations, purposeful hold/calibration baselines

criteria.name: Measurement/uncertainty/no pseudoreplication
criteria.acceptance_evidence: Predeclared agreement/dispersion and forecasting/dissent endpoints, meeting-unit paired estimates, temporal uncertainty, replication and missingness sensitivity

criteria.name: Integrated reproducibility/provenance/failure transparency
criteria.acceptance_evidence: Immutable input/config/code/raw identities, bounded accounting, fail-closed execution, independent source-to-result recomputation and corruption controls

criteria.name: Conclusions proportional to evidence
criteria.acceptance_evidence: Simulator-local scope, separate adaptation/contribution/readiness conclusions; nulls/failures retained; no certification or unsupported causal/welfare claim
